confounding_and_scope_disclosure.fresh_vs_stale_arm_definition: In Stage 2A, the 'Fresh' arm uses Prometheus telemetry-aware routing compiled against the live ibm_kingston calibration snapshot, whereas the 'Stale' arm uses Qiskit SABRE O3 compiled against a mismatched donor calibration map (ibm_fez / ibm_marrakesh). Because both the compiler (Prometheus vs. SABRE O3) and the calibration/placement map differ between the two arms, their difference (+0.0296 F_B in Window T0, +0.0161 F_B in South Sector T1, +0.0080 F_B in North Sector T1) measures joint compiler + telemetry-placement sensitivity rather than isolated temporal calibration aging.
confounding_and_scope_disclosure.pure_temporal_drift_control: Pure temporal hardware drift is isolated by the 4 Unchanged Physical Reference Circuits (Ref4: identical physical qubits and compiled gate sequences executed in Window T0 and Window T1 +88 min with zero recompilation), which measured +0.0130 F_B (North Sector) and +0.0054 F_B (South Sector).

unchanged_ref4_observed_changes_with_unc.interpretation: Observed changes over +88 minutes on the N = 4 unchanged physical reference circuits (+0.0054 +/- 0.0087 F_B in North Sector, two-sided paired p = 0.5792; +0.0130 +/- 0.0078 F_B in South Sector, two-sided paired p = 0.1957) are small and within finite-shot/circuit sampling variation.
